_readme: Screen Space Reflections - puddle-only, roughness-gated, sprite-aware. T1 live-edit via SSRBlock UBO binding=2.
note: v1 gated to puddles via modifierMap.b mask + roughTarget 0.04. 640x360 early-exit fullscreen pass.

gating.note: Only floor where puddle mask > min gets SSR

rayMarch.note: Linear + binary refine, thickness tolerant to POM + floorDepress

reprojection.note: View ray from playerPos/Angle/FOV + gBuffer depth B=perpDist/depthRange

composition.note: lerp base/mirror by fresnel*mask*blend, tint water, quantize after

debug.note: Key 7 cycles, bright viz before quantize

gating.puddleOnly: true = only floor where modifierMap.b > minPuddleMask gets SSR. false = walls too (expensive).
gating.minPuddleMask: 0-1 threshold on computePuddleMaskTweakable. 0.18 skips faint feather, keeps sharp interior.
gating.roughnessThreshold: Max roughness still reflecting. Puddle roughTarget 0.04 gate 0.18 glossy only.
gating.normalThreshold: Min N.z for flat water, avoids grout verticals. 0.35 mostly flat.
gating.facingOnly: Only when looking down onto puddle.

rayMarch.thickness: Depth tolerance 0.35 tolerant POM wobble + floorDepress -0.08.
rayMarch.depthBias: Lift along N to avoid self-intersect 0.015.

fade.edgeFadeStart: Screen UV fade start 0.82 near border

docs.system: MRT GBuffer: COLOR0 sceneColor RGBA8 lit+sprites, COLOR1 gNormalDepth RGBA16F RG octa normal XY B linear depth/depthRange A puddleMask, COLOR2 gMaterial optional. UBO SSRBlock binding=2 192 bytes like ModifiersBlock for T1 live-edit. Fullscreen fsSSR 20+4 steps puddle-masked earlyExit 0.6-1.2ms. Sprites write depth+color so SSR sees monsters.
